title: Two Repos That Fix AI Slop Videos
caption:
Most AI videos look like slop. Two open source repos try to fix that. 🎨🎬

1) Vox Director: give it a topic and it builds a paper collage explainer video (needs an API key).
2) Huashu Art Motion: builds a short film from an art direction, with 35 art style recipes, drawn in code.

Both are MIT licensed and work as Claude Code skills. Not affiliated with either project. Always check each repo's README before using it.

Paper collage, or moving painting? Comment STYLE and tag a friend who makes videos. Follow @StickMindR8!
